title: FULL LOCAL-W20 CANDIDATE EXPOSURE
natq_validation_status: DEVELOPMENT / MODEL-SELECTION DATA; not independent validation

hypothesis.statement: Existing parent-local BM25 W=20 lists already contain useful gold evidence that SYSTEM-H's global L=10 promotion discards. Exposing the full existing W=20 lists (unioned with the frozen SYSTEM-H candidate pool, additive only) improves candidate evidence coverage versus SYSTEM-H on NATQ-001 validation n=40 (development / model-selection data).

pipeline.reuse_SYSTEM_H_candidate_generation: A pool-100 + E-L10 L=10 + projection C_P P=20, exact existing code. Recompute because stored EVAL-NATQ-VAL-001 pools.jsonl lacks full union member ids. Reuse stored parent lists after identical recomputation check. No CE.
pipeline.additive_full_local_w20: After existing parent-local W=20 lists are computed via local_bm25_per_parent_batched (cs_v1_control, full-corpus IDF, same tokenizer, W=20, ORDER BY round(score numeric 9) DESC, chunk_id ASC) for exact SYSTEM-H parents only: UNION every unique canonical chunk_id from every selected parent's existing W=20 list into the SYSTEM-H candidate union. Deduplicate by canonical chunk_id. Never remove SYSTEM-H candidates. Does not increase W. Does not run a different BM25 search. Full W=20 lists were not serialized in EVAL-NATQ-VAL-001 or EXP-020A (EXP-020A stored top-1 only), so they are recomputed with identical E-L10 semantics.
pipeline.union: SYSTEM-H existing union (C_E UNION C_P) UNION all unique canonical chunk_ids from every selected parent's existing W=20 list; dedupe canonical chunk_id; never remove SYSTEM-H candidate. Exact superset or equal set vs SYSTEM-H for every query.
pipeline.unchanged_global_lanes: E-L10 global L=10 intact. Frozen SYSTEM-H global P=20 projection lane unchanged. EXP-020A parent-balanced projection top-1 is NOT included.
